about: Batch 04, slice A, chunk A37: lunch stuffed potatoes, savoury pancakes and crepes, pasta, cold summer platters and kid-friendly lunches.

recipes.title: Baked Potato with Chilli Beef
recipes.summary: A crisp-skinned baked potato filled with spicy beef and bean chilli, soured cream and cheese.
steps: Prick the potatoes, rub with oil and salt and bake at 200°C until the skins are crisp and the middle is soft, about 60 minutes.
Meanwhile brown the beef and onion in a pan until the beef is no longer pink, about 6 minutes.
Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute, then the beans and tomatoes and simmer until thick, about 20 minutes.
Split the potatoes, spoon in the chilli and top with the cheese and sour cream.
notes: Food safety: beef mince must reach 75°C and be cooked until no pink remains.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Baked Potato with Tuna and Corn
recipes.summary: Fluffy baked potato topped with tuna, sweetcorn, spring onion and a spoon of mayonnaise.
steps: Prick the potatoes, rub with oil and bake at 200°C until the skins are crisp and the middle is soft, about 60 minutes.
Mix the tuna with the corn, spring onion, mayonnaise and lemon juice.
Split the potatoes, fluff the insides, spoon in the filling and scatter with the cheese.
notes: Food safety: keep the tuna filling below 5°C if you make it ahead and eat within 2 days.
Contains fish, egg and milk.

recipes.title: Baked Potato with Cheesy Broccoli
recipes.summary: Baked potato stuffed with broccoli and a cheddar-style cheese sauce, an easy vegetarian lunch.
steps: Prick the potatoes, rub with oil and bake at 200°C until the skins are crisp and the middle is soft, about 60 minutes.
Steam the broccoli until just tender, about 4 minutes.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk and simmer until thickened, about 4 minutes.
Stir in the cheese and mustard until melted, then fold in the broccoli.
Split the potatoes and spoon the sauce over.
notes: Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Twice-Baked Potatoes with Bacon and Chives
recipes.summary: Potato shells refilled with a creamy mash of cheese, bacon and chives and baked until golden.
steps: Prick the potatoes, rub with oil and bake at 200°C until soft inside, about 60 minutes.
Fry the bacon until crisp, about 6 minutes.
Halve the potatoes, scoop out the flesh into a bowl leaving a thin shell, and mash with the sour cream, butter, two-thirds of the cheese, bacon and chives.
Refill the shells, top with the remaining cheese and bake at 200°C until golden and bubbling, about 15 minutes.
notes: Food safety: cook bacon until well done with no pink, and eat the potatoes piping hot.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Buckwheat Galettes with Ham, Egg and Cheese
recipes.summary: Brittany-style buckwheat crepes folded around ham, melted cheese and a runny-edged egg.
steps: Whisk the buckwheat flour, plain flour, egg, water, melted butter and a pinch of salt into a smooth batter and rest for 15 minutes.
Cook a thin ladle of batter in a buttered hot pan until the edges lift and the underside is crisp, about 2 minutes.
Flip, scatter with a quarter of the cheese and ham, crack an egg in the middle and cook until the white is set, about 3 minutes.
Fold the edges in to a square and serve at once; repeat for the rest.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg until the white is set and the yolk warm; use firm yolks for young children, pregnant people or older adults.
Contains gluten, egg and milk.

recipes.title: Savoury Crepes with Spinach and Ricotta
recipes.summary: Thin crepes rolled around a spinach, ricotta and lemon filling and baked in a light tomato sauce.
steps: Whisk the flour, eggs, milk, melted butter and a pinch of salt into a thin batter and rest for 10 minutes.
Cook 8 thin crepes in a lightly buttered pan until golden underneath, about 1 minute each side.
Squeeze the spinach dry and mix with the ricotta, lemon zest and salt.
Fill and roll the crepes, then lay them in a dish over the passata.
Top with the cheese and bake at 190°C until bubbling and golden, about 18 minutes.
notes: Contains gluten, egg and milk.

recipes.title: Dutch Pannenkoeken with Bacon and Cheese
recipes.summary: Big thin Dutch pancakes cooked with crisp bacon and melted cheese, served flat and folded.
steps: Whisk the flour, eggs, milk and a pinch of salt into a smooth batter.
Fry the bacon in a large non-stick pan until crisp, about 5 minutes.
Add a little butter, pour in a third of the batter and scatter with a third of the bacon.
Cook until the underside is golden, flip, add a third of the cheese and cook until it melts, about 2 minutes.
Fold and serve; repeat for the rest.
notes: Food safety: cook bacon until well done with no pink.
Contains gluten, egg and milk.

recipes.title: Okonomiyaki (Japanese Cabbage Pancakes)
recipes.summary: Thick savoury cabbage pancakes with pork belly slices, brushed with sweet sauce and mayonnaise.
steps: Whisk the flour and water into a batter, then fold in the cabbage, eggs and spring onions.
Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan and spoon in a third of the mixture to make a thick round.
Lay a third of the bacon over the top and cook for 5 minutes until golden underneath.
Flip and cook until the bacon is crisp and the centre is set, about 5 minutes more.
Brush with tonkatsu sauce and drizzle with mayonnaise; repeat for the rest.
notes: Food safety: cook until the centre is fully set and the bacon is well done.
Contains gluten, egg and soy.

recipes.title: Corn Fritter Stack with Avocado and Lime
recipes.summary: Golden sweetcorn fritters stacked with smashed avocado, lime and sour cream.
steps: Mix the flour, eggs, milk, corn, spring onions, cumin and salt into a thick batter.
Fry spoonfuls in the oil over medium heat for 3 minutes each side until golden and set through.
Mash the avocado with the lime juice and salt.
Stack the fritters with the avocado and sour cream.
notes: Food safety: cook the fritters until the centres are set and no longer wet.
Contains gluten, egg and milk.

recipes.title: Orecchiette with Broccoli and Anchovy
recipes.summary: Puglian orecchiette with soft broccoli, anchovy, garlic and chilli, a classic southern Italian lunch.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water for 10 minutes, adding the broccoli for the last 5 minutes, until both are very tender.
Melt the anchovies in the oil over low heat with the garlic and chilli until the anchovy dissolves, about 3 minutes.
Toast the breadcrumbs in a dry pan until golden, about 3 minutes.
Drain the pasta and broccoli, toss in the anchovy oil, crushing the broccoli, and top with the crumbs.
notes: Contains gluten and fish.

recipes.title: Tuna Pasta with Capers and Cherry Tomatoes
recipes.summary: Quick pasta with tuna, blistered cherry tomatoes, capers and olives.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente and drain, keeping a little water.
Fry the garlic in the oil for 30 seconds, add the tomatoes and cook until they burst and turn jammy, about 7 minutes.
Stir in the capers, olives and tuna and warm through.
Toss with the spaghetti, parsley and a splash of cooking water.
notes: Food safety: keep opened tinned tuna covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days.
Contains gluten and fish.

recipes.title: Pesto Pasta Bowl with Green Beans and Potato
recipes.summary: Trofie-style pasta tossed with basil pesto, green beans and soft potato, the Ligurian way.

items: 100g green beans, cut into short lengths

steps: Boil the potato in salted water for 5 minutes, then add the pasta and cook until al dente, adding the beans for the last 3 minutes.
Keep a mug of the water and drain.
Toss everything with the pesto and enough water to make it creamy, then serve with the cheese.
notes: Contains gluten, milk and tree nuts (pesto).

recipes.title: Cold Sesame Soba Noodle Plate with Cucumber and Egg
recipes.summary: Chilled buckwheat noodles in a nutty sesame-soy dressing with cucumber and egg.
steps: Cook the soba until tender, about 5 minutes, then rinse under cold water and drain well.
Whisk the tahini, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and sesame oil with 2 tbsp water until smooth.
Toss the noodles and cucumber in the dressing.
Top with eggs and spring onions.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs for at least 8 minutes until firm.
Contains gluten (most soba), egg, soy and sesame.

recipes.title: Summer Platter with Poached Chicken, Fruit and Dips
recipes.summary: Cold poached chicken, sliced fruit and crunchy vegetables with two easy dips for a hot day.
steps: Poach the chicken with the bay leaf in simmering water until cooked through and the juices run clear, about 16 minutes, then chill.
Slice the chicken and stir the mint into the yoghurt.
Arrange the chicken, hummus, minty yoghurt, vegetables, mango and cheese on a platter.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C; chill quickly and keep the platter below 5°C, serving within 2 hours at room temperature.
Contains milk and sesame.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Cold Noodle Platter with Herbs and Pork
recipes.summary: Rice vermicelli with grilled pork, lettuce, cucumber and herbs with a sweet-sharp nuoc cham dressing.
steps: Toss the pork with 1 tbsp fish sauce, half the sugar and the garlic and leave 15 minutes.
Grill or pan-fry the pork over high heat until browned and cooked through, about 4 minutes.
Soak the vermicelli in boiling water until tender, about 4 minutes, rinse cold and drain.
Whisk the remaining fish sauce and sugar with the lime juice, chilli and 3 tbsp water into nuoc cham.
Arrange the noodles with the pork, salad and herbs, then dress and scatter with peanuts.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach 70°C with no pink; keep marinating pork below 5°C.
Contains fish and peanuts.

recipes.title: Prawn Cocktail Lunch Platter with Avocado
recipes.summary: Sweet prawns in a classic marie rose sauce with avocado, lettuce, egg and brown bread.
steps: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes until firm, cool in cold water and peel.
Stir the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and lemon juice into a pink sauce.
Toss the prawns in the sauce.
Plate the lettuce, avocado, cucumber and egg with the prawns on top, and serve with the bread.
notes: Food safety: keep cooked prawns below 5°C and eat within 2 days; boil eggs until the yolk is firm.
Contains egg, gluten and shellfish.

recipes.title: Hidden Vegetable Mac and Cheese
recipes.summary: Creamy cheese sauce with blended butternut and carrot hidden inside, a kid-friendly pasta lunch.
steps: Boil the pumpkin and carrot until very soft, about 15 minutes, then blend with a ladle of the water until smooth.
Cook the macaroni in salted water until tender and drain.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute and whisk in the milk, simmering until thickened.
Stir in the blended vegetables, cheese and mustard until melted, then fold through the macaroni.
notes: Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Crumbed Chicken Strips Lunchbox with Veggie Sticks
recipes.summary: Baked crumbed chicken strips with cucumber, carrot, cheese and a mild yoghurt dip for kids.
steps: Dip the chicken strips in the egg, then the breadcrumbs, and lay them on a tray brushed with the oil.
Bake at 200°C until golden and cooked through, about 16 minutes, turning once.
Stir the yoghurt with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Pack the strips with the vegetable sticks and dip.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C and have no pink; for a lunchbox use an insulated bag with an ice pack and eat within 4 hours.
Contains gluten, egg and milk.

recipes.title: Fish Finger Wraps for Kids with Crunchy Slaw
recipes.summary: Crumbed baked white fish strips in soft wraps with a mild carrot and cabbage slaw.

items: 400g white fish fillets, cut into strips

steps: Dip the fish in the egg, then the breadcrumbs, and lay on a tray brushed with the oil.
Bake at 200°C until golden and the fish flakes easily, about 12 minutes.
Mix the cabbage, carrot and mayonnaise into a slaw.
Fill the tortillas with the slaw and fish and roll up.
notes: Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking; check for bones before serving to young children.
Contains fish, gluten, egg and milk.

recipes.title: Ham and Cheese Pinwheels for Lunchboxes
recipes.summary: Soft wraps spread with cream cheese and rolled with ham, cheese and cucumber, sliced into easy spirals.
steps: Spread each tortilla with cream cheese right to the edges until evenly covered.
Layer the ham, cheese, carrot and cucumber across each wrap.
Roll up tightly and chill for 20 minutes until firm.
Slice into spirals with a sharp knife.
notes: Food safety: ham should stay below 5°C; pack with an ice pack and eat within 4 hours.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Mini Frittata Muffins for Toddlers
recipes.summary: Soft little egg muffins with zucchini, corn and cheese, easy for small hands and good cold.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the milk and a pinch of salt.
Squeeze the water from the zucchini and stir into the eggs with the corn and cheese.
Pour into a 12-hole muffin tin brushed with the oil.
Bake at 180°C until puffed and set in the middle, about 16 minutes.
notes: Food safety: bake until fully set with no liquid egg; keep below 5°C and eat within 2 days.
Contains egg and milk.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato and Chickpea Toddler Patties
recipes.summary: Soft, mildly spiced patties of sweet potato and chickpea, baked and served with yoghurt.
steps: Boil the sweet potato until very soft, about 12 minutes, then drain.
Mash with the chickpeas and cumin until mostly smooth.
Stir in the egg and breadcrumbs, then shape into 12 patties.
Brush with the oil and bake at 200°C until golden on both sides, about 20 minutes, turning once, and serve with the yoghurt.
notes: Food safety: bake until firm and hot throughout.
Contains gluten, egg and milk.

recipes.title: Pasta Lunchbox with Corn, Cheese and Ham
recipes.summary: Cold pasta with sweetcorn, cucumber, ham and cheese in a light yoghurt dressing, built for the lunchbox.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water until tender, about 10 minutes, drain and rinse under cold water until cool.
Stir the yoghurt, mayonnaise and lemon juice together.
Fold the pasta, corn, cucumber, ham and cheese through the dressing.
Pack into containers with an ice pack.
notes: Food safety: keep below 5°C, pack with an ice pack and eat within 4 hours.
Contains gluten, egg and milk.

recipes.title: Apple and Ricotta Pancake Fingers
recipes.summary: Soft apple and ricotta pancakes cut into fingers, lightly sweet for a gentle kids lunch.
steps: Squeeze the grated apples dry and mix with the ricotta, then whisk in the eggs and milk.
Fold in the flour and baking powder until just combined.
Cook spoonfuls in the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat until golden underneath and bubbles appear, about 3 minutes, then flip and cook 2 minutes more.
Cut into fingers and serve with the yoghurt.
notes: Food safety: cook until the middle is set with no wet batter.
Contains gluten, egg and milk.
